title: Introduction to Tajweed
description: Learn the fundamentals of Tajweed (proper Quranic recitation) including basic rules of pronunciation, articulation points, and recitation patterns.
short_description: Master the basics of proper Quranic recitation

modules.title: Fundamentals of Tajweed
modules.description: Introduction to the science of Tajweed and its importance in Quranic recitation.

lessons.title: What is Tajweed?
lessons.content: Understanding the meaning of Tajweed (تَجْوِيد) and why it is obligatory (wajib) to observe the rules when reciting the Quran.

lessons.title: Articulation Points (Makharij)
lessons.content: Learning the Makharij al-Huruf (مَخَارِج الحُرُوف) - the points of articulation for each Arabic letter in the Quran.

lessons.title: Characteristics of Letters (Sifat)
lessons.content: Understanding the Sifat (صِفَات) or characteristics of Arabic letters including strength, softness, and other qualities.

modules.title: Basic Rules of Tajweed
modules.description: Essential rules that every beginner must learn for proper Quranic recitation.

lessons.title: Rules of Noon Sakinah and Tanwin
lessons.content: The four rules of Noon Sakinah (نُون سَاكِنَة) and Tanwin (تَنْوِين): Izhar, Idgham, Iqlab, and Ikhfa.

lessons.title: Rules of Meem Sakinah
lessons.content: The three rules of Meem Sakinah (مِيم سَاكِنَة): Ikhfa Shafawi, Idgham Shafawi, and Izhar Shafawi.

lessons.title: Madd (Elongation) Rules
lessons.content: Understanding Madd (مَدّ) or elongation rules, including natural, necessary, and forbidden elongations in Quranic recitation.
